videos.script: Lesson 4 ended with two good alerts. Somebody now has to do something about them. {{alerts}} The first ten minutes of that are the same every time. Look up the address. Count what it tried. See what it got into. Open a ticket. SOAR is the name for doing those minutes with a machine. {{soar}} In this lesson you write a small playbook that does them in a second, and then stops. It proposes. A named person approves. Only then does it touch the firewall. {{approve}} And it refuses some things outright, like blocking the company's own backup provider. {{refuse}} That refusal is the part most teams forget to write.
